input.summary: Add a Client ownership provision covering Client Content, Client Intellectual Property, Client data and Support Services deliverables, with a licence back for embedded TrueLink IP.
input.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement confirms TrueLink's ownership of the Interface but says nothing about what we own, so we have added a reciprocal provision: we retain all right, title and interest in Client Content, Client's Intellectual Property and our borrower, loan and other data, and we own the results of the Support Services with a licence back to TrueLink's pre-existing IP embedded in them. Our position is that we own what we pay for and everything we put in, with no joint ownership; if TrueLink prefers, we can instead take a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, modify and sublicense those results for our business.

ops.text: e. Client Ownership. Notwithstanding anything to the contrary herein, Client retains all right, title and interest in and to the Client Content, Client's Intellectual Property, the Web Site and all data provided by or on behalf of Client or its customers or borrowers (including borrower and loan data), and TrueLink acquires no ownership right therein, the license granted in Section 8(d) being a limited, nonexclusive license only. All results of the Support Services and any other deliverables, work product, customizations or materials created by TrueLink for Client under this Agreement shall be owned exclusively by Client, and TrueLink hereby assigns all right, title and interest therein to Client; provided that TrueLink retains ownership of TrueLink's Intellectual Property existing prior to or developed independently of such work, and grants Client a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free license to use, modify and sublicense any TrueLink Intellectual Property embedded in such results or deliverables for Client's business purposes. No item of intellectual property shall be jointly owned by the parties.
